packageRules.description: Automerge minor & patch updates (dependencies AND devDependencies).
Never automerge major updates — they need human validation.

astro/@astrojs/cloudflare are EXACT-PINNED: 7.2.0/14.2.0 break `astro dev` (vite route-cache SSR error; CI only builds, so it would merge green). Updates stay manual PRs — verify `astro dev` locally before merging.
typescript 7.x is the new native compiler — NOT yet supported by the Astro/Volar toolchain (@astrojs/check peerDependencies: ^5 || ^6). Never propose it.
